APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

silicone glass marker, pick or straw

Outdoor Bars ↗

A small reusable silicone piece: When glasses change hands, the marker says whose is whose.

Yacht Parties ↗

Cups get set down on deck and mixed up — the marker settles it.

Corporate Events & Branded Gifts ↗

Boxed with a glass and it reads as a set.

Confirm for your project

Check service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；deck grip, how stable the shape is and the operator's container rules；the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
